originalTitle: Groww responds to Nithin Kamath tweet: Direct mutual funds remain free for DIY investors
simplifiedContent: Groww, an investment platform, has confirmed that it will continue to offer direct mutual funds for free to individual investors who manage their own investments. This means that people who use Groww to buy and sell mutual funds on their own won't have to pay any extra fees. Groww made this announcement after there was some uncertainty about the cost of mutual funds on the platform. This matters because it helps individual investors save money on fees and keep more of their investment returns. By keeping direct mutual funds free, Groww is sticking to its promise of offering zero-commission investments to its users.

originalTitle: Sebi cancels registration of 12 research analysts over unpaid renewal fees
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market regulator, Sebi, has cancelled the registration of 12 research analysts because they didn't pay their renewal fees. This means these analysts can no longer provide research and advice to investors. Sebi had sent them notices, but they didn't respond or pay the fees, so Sebi took this action. This matters because it helps Sebi ensure that only reliable and responsible analysts are providing information to investors. By cancelling their registration, Sebi is protecting investors from potentially untrustworthy sources of advice.

originalTitle: Costco shares fall over 4% as investors look past strong June sales
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening with Costco's stock: despite having strong sales in June, the company's stock price fell by over 4%. This might seem surprising, but investors are looking beyond the good sales numbers and are worried about how much the company's stock is worth compared to its actual value. They're also concerned about uneven sales growth in different regions, particularly in Canada where sales were weaker. This is causing investors to be more cautious and sell their shares, which is why the stock price is falling. Overall, investors are being very careful when it comes to expensive consumer stocks like Costco.

originalTitle: HDFC Bank Q1 results date: Private lender to announce June quarter earnings on 18 July
simplifiedContent: HDFC Bank, a private bank, will announce its earnings for the quarter ending June on July 18. This means they will share how the bank performed financially during that time. The bank's Board of Directors will meet on July 18 to approve the financial results before they are made public. This matters because it will give investors an idea of how the bank is doing and help them decide what to do with their investments. The results will provide a snapshot of the bank's financial health for the quarter.

originalTitle: Russia's largest private lender Alfa Bank tests crypto trading, plans suite of crypto services ahead of govt legislation
simplifiedContent: Alfa Bank, a big bank in Russia, is trying out a new feature that allows people to buy and sell cryptocurrencies, like Bitcoin, through its app. The bank is planning to offer more services related to cryptocurrencies in the future. This is happening before the Russian government makes new rules about digital assets, which are like cryptocurrencies. This matters because it shows that a major bank is getting involved in the cryptocurrency market, which could make it more accessible to regular people. The bank's move may be a sign that cryptocurrencies are becoming more mainstream and widely accepted.

originalTitle: Multibagger defence stock Apollo Micro Systems to be in focus on Friday; here's why
simplifiedContent: Apollo Micro Systems, a company that helps with defense, is going to be closely watched on Friday. This is because they just agreed to buy a large part (41.33%) of another company called Premier Explosives for ₹1,550 crore. The goal of this purchase is to help make India's defense stronger. As part of the deal, Apollo Micro Systems will also try to buy more shares from other owners of Premier Explosives. The whole deal should be finished by December 2026.
